reproduction_note: Eighth round on L9. Tested the alternate-win-condition hypothesis (score field, activate-everything, full connectivity search, uncatalogued-glyph scan). All deterministic; the census + activate-everything results reproduce exactly on re-run.

reproducibility_checksum_note: sha256 of the deterministic color-census summary (states + union colors + frame_score_present + win_levels); see color_census field.
narrative: Eighth round on L9 (final level of bp35), testing the team-lead-suggested alternate-win-condition hypothesis (since rounds 13-19 showed navigating the player to the goal diamond appears impossible). No win; frontier stays at level 8. FOUR tests, all null: (1) NO SCORE FIELD -- frame.score is not even an attribute (raises AttributeError); getattr(...,None) is None in every reachable state. This game tracks no incremental/collection counter separate from level completion, so a state-collection win would have to directly flip levels_completed/state. Ruled out as a partial-credit signal. (2) NO UNCATALOGUED LIVE GLYPH -- the color set was censused across 9 distinct reachable states (start, flip-up, fall-through landing, +1 door, +3 doors, up-gravity pocket, goal-sighting, corridor); the union is exactly {0,3,5,7,8,9,10,11,14,15}, all already catalogued (bg / accent / wall / goal-or-HUD / switch / player / air / eye / door / pillar). color-12 (toggle) and 13 never appear in ANY live state, reconfirming round 19's finding that the 'toggle blocks' are GAME_OVER-overview-only, not live-interactable. (3) ACTIVATE-EVERYTHING -- clicking every reachable interactive object (doors, pillars, switches) in one continuous session (no reset between) produced no win and no state change (still L8/NOT_FINISHED); there is no 'collect/activate a full set' win condition triggerable from the reachable region. (4) CONNECTIVITY SEARCH -- a full naive reachability BFS is computationally INTRACTABLE to exhaust because pillar-growth is a cosmetic state change (grid-hash dedup counts every distinct set of grown pillars as a new state, exploding the frontier); a RESTRICTED reachability BFS (player moves + switch/door clicks, which bounds the branching) over the fall-through region did NOT find any win. NET: all four alternate-win-condition avenues are null, and the topological seal established in rounds 18-19 stands as the best-supported explanation -- the player is confined to cols>=13 in every reachable state (solid cols6-12 wall, rows0-40), the goal diamond sits in an open pocket below the main floor whose only vertical opening (cols0-5) is on the far side of that wall, and both live descents (the leftmost-door shaft goes UP; the pillar gap lands in the fall-through room) demonstrably miss the goal. bp35 L9 is a well-characterized structural null: 8 of 9 levels banked, the final goal located and repeatedly sighted but not reachable by any navigation or activation path found across 8 rounds. Recommending pause.
novel_mechanics_found: frame.score does not exist (no scoring/collection counter); the win is purely level-completion state.
The union of live-reachable colors is exactly {0,3,5,7,8,9,10,11,14,15}; no uncatalogued interactive glyph exists in the reachable region (color-12/13 are overview-only or absent).
No 'activate/collect a full set' win: clicking every reachable interactive object in one session does not complete the level.
dead_ends: frame.score as a partial-credit signal (field does not exist).
full naive reachability BFS (intractable: pillar-growth cosmetics explode the grid-state space).
restricted reachability BFS over the fall-through region (moves + switch/door clicks) found no win.

connectivity_bfs.restricted_bfs_scope: from fall-through landing; candidate actions = moves(left,right) + ACTION6 clicks on switch(c8)/door(c14) centroids; pillar-grow clicks excluded to bound branching
connectivity_bfs.restricted_bfs_result: explored 118 unique reachable grid-states (100 nodes expanded, frontier 18, max depth 8) via moves + switch/door clicks from the fall-through landing; 0 wins. STOPPED BEFORE EXHAUSTION (not exhaustive) -- the frontier was still non-empty and the reachable space via gravity+doors is larger than 118, but no win surfaced in the region searched, and no state placed the player in the goal pocket. Caveat: this is a partial coverage number, not a proof of unreachability; it corroborates but does not by itself close the question.

acceptance_gates.principle: Only a reproduced level-9 win counts as banked progress; this round is an honest HONEST_NULL that closes the alternate-win-condition hypothesis (no score field, no collection win, no hidden glyph) and leaves the topological seal as the best-supported explanation.
